name: Autoresearch
tagline: Let an AI agent run ML experiments autonomously overnight on a single GPU.
description: Give an AI agent a real LLM training setup and let it experiment autonomously. It modifies train.py, trains for 5 minutes, checks if val_bpb improved, keeps or discards, and repeats — waking you up to a log of experiments and a better model. Based on Karpathy's nanochat training setup.
author: karpathy
suitable_for: ML researchers with a single NVIDIA GPU
